roster_premise.claim_reviewed: Aurora had a recent roster change that could justify an upset pick.
roster_premise.finding: Aurora's current five is the July 2026 rebuild, not an October change. HLTV dates kyxsan's arrival to 8 July 2026 and the article records Jimpphat and coach ash joining the same day; the team page lists the same five that appear in Valve's 5 October roster file. No onboarding factor applies on 18 October.

hotspawn_listing.finding: The CS2 pick'em page listed 81 board fixtures in its current filter and its tournament filter names 'Thunderpick World Championship 2026: South American Series #1' but not the main Thunderpick World Championship 2026 event. Neither Day-5 TWC fixture is a board row, so neither can be submitted in the pick'em and neither carries pick'em points.

limitations: Only one bookmaker (Thunderpick, the event sponsor) exposed a two-way Day-5 match price at the observation time. A second cross-check was sought and not found: HLTV's betting pages exposed no numeric line; Pinnacle's public matchups feed read at 20:10Z carried no TWC Day-5 fixture (only historical semi-final ids were readable through the project probe); and Polymarket had no head-to-head Day-5 market at 20:22Z.

The Thunderpick tournament card and the Thunderpick market page disagreed on the third-place price in reads one minute apart (+150/-208 versus +170/-238). The market page is published; the disagreement is flagged for review and is not presented as a line move.
American prices are settlement-relevant only at the moment they are accepted; these are dated observations, not live quotes.
Day-5 TWC fixtures are not Hotspawn board rows, so these probabilities are research/analysis picks and not leaderboard picks.
